units.source_text: 这是五月的一天，天气晴朗。

en.t: It was a clear day in May.

units.source_text: 坡道索车已经长久不使用，牵引索车的坡道上的轨道长满了铁锈，几乎被杂草埋没了。

en.t: The cable car on the slope had long been out of use, and the tracks on the incline that pulled the cars were covered with rust, almost buried in weeds.

units.source_text: 在这杂草上的十字形小白花随风摇曳，直至索车坡道都淤积污水，浸满着这边岸上的叶樱①街树的投影。

en.t: Small white cross-shaped flowers among the weeds swayed in the wind, while stagnant dirty water had collected all the way up the cable-car slope, filled with the reflections of the leafy cherry trees lining this bank.
